Container.Name: Gibsons-Broadband-Monitor
Container.Overview: Gibson's Broadband Monitor is a self-hosted internet speed and reliability monitor with a modern dashboard available in 16 languages. Features include automatic browser-language detection, scheduled speed testing, historical graphs, 24-hour to all-time statistics, host network data usage logging with daily charts and an optional monthly warning level, outage tracking and optional phone notifications.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: speedtest broadband internet speed connection monitoring uptime outage latency graphs statistics multilingual multi-language translations notifications alerts server network usage data bandwidth traffic bytes rx tx
Container.Description: Self-hosted broadband monitoring for Unraid and Docker. The dashboard supports 16 languages, including Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Swedish and major European languages, with automatic browser-language detection and manual selection. Includes scheduled download/upload/latency tests, interactive history charts, selectable 24-hour, weekly, monthly, yearly and all-time speed/latency statistics and uptime/outage totals, uptime and outage logs, CSV export, and optional ntfy notifications for outages, recovery and low speeds. A dedicated Server Network Usage page records receive/transmit byte totals on a selected host interface, displays volume charts for 24h through all time, CSV exports and monthly usage warnings. Requires the host counters file mounted read-only. Measurements remain in local persistent SQLite storage; no cloud account required. Beta release.

Config.Name: Host Network Counters (read only)
Config.Description: Read-only host interface RX/TX counters. Required to measure whole-server network traffic while retaining Docker bridge mode.
